interface.acceptance: One input byte at every rising clock edge except during reset; no handshake.

semantics.evidence: problem.txt: discard bytes until in[3]=1, receive three bytes, signal done in the cycle immediately after the third byte; active high synchronous reset; positive-edge sequential logic.
semantics.framing: While searching, in[3]=0 is discarded and in[3]=1 starts a message. The next two bytes are accepted regardless of their bit 3.
semantics.cycle: If byte 1 is sampled at edge k, byte 2 at k+1 and byte 3 at k+2, done is high after edge k+2 until edge k+3. The byte at k+3 is immediately eligible to start another message.
semantics.reset: reset=1 at a positive edge clears framing progress and done. Changes to reset between edges have no immediate effect.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value is specified; verification begins checking defined behavior after a synchronous reset. No RTL initialization is added.

numeric.input: Unsigned 8-bit byte, only bit 3 participates in framing
numeric.arithmetic: None; four-state FSM encoded in two bits
